method: Matched mock fixture; 50 warmup commands, fixed 3s drain, alternating order; direct runtime process CPU/RSS. Inspect missing/rejected before comparing received-only latency.

result.note: Host wall-clock roundtrip publish->CommandResult callback; includes DDS, executor and benchmark client spin. Mock backend; percentiles include received samples only, so always inspect missing and rejected counts. No hard real-time or hardware claim.

runtime_process.note: CPU interval includes warmup and a fixed 3-second final drain for both implementations; VmHWM includes startup. Direct runtime process only, excludes benchmark client.
